title: LALACHAN World Travel — Italy Is Still Writing This Page
brief: A single coherent journey from Rome to Florence to Venice, carried by wind turning the patchwork notebook's pages. Preserve exactly one Rara Xia, one Aya Chan, one Sasa Kun and one Zhuangzi Robot with unchanged faces, species, proportions, wardrobe, props, relationships and Mandarin voices. Time moves naturally from dawn to blue hour and screen travel keeps moving forward. The named earlier Iran dialogue reference controls familiar character voice timbre only: never copy its country, architecture, palette, music, ambience, plot, action, blocking, camera or story direction. Each current Picture 8 is authoritative for that shot's Italian geography. Use only the exact quoted Mandarin dialogue, with clean lip sync and no narration, subtitles, labels, UI or extra text. shots.title: Rome — the wind opens the first page
shots.prompt: One continuous stable cinematic tracking shot in 4:3. Match <Picture 8> exactly for the dawn Colosseum exterior, authentic Roman stone, arch scale, road direction and warm natural light; exclude Florence, Venice and Iran. At 0–2s the four friends walk from lower left toward the right foreground; wind opens Aya's patchwork notebook, its physical <Picture 1> HERITAGE card slips halfway out, and Sasa catches it naturally. At 2–6s Rara looks up at the immense arches and says clearly: ‘这么大的圆圈，真能坐满吗？’ At 6–9s Aya waits until he finishes, points to the stone road toward the Roman Forum and answers: ‘能。可罗马人不只来看比赛。’ At 9–10s all four keep the same forward screen direction toward a centered arch; camera lowers toward the stone road and holds the arch as an explicit transition path. Speak only those two lines with accurate Mandarin lip sync. Native stereo: light wind, sparse morning footsteps, distant modern city and soft paper; restrained original music below speech. No subtitles, narration, historical reconstruction montage, duplicate cast or extra protagonist.
